import requests

def get_uniprot_info(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene_exact:{gene_symbol}+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true&format=json"
    res = requests.get(url).json()
    for entry in res.get('results', []):
        acc = entry['primaryAccession']
        name = entry['uniProtkbId']
        seq = entry['sequence']
        mass_da = seq['molWeight']
        length = seq['length']
        print(f"Gene: {gene_symbol}, Accession: {acc}, ID: {name}, Length: {length} aa, Mass: {mass_da} Da ({mass_da/1000:.2f} kDa)")

get_uniprot_info("BMP10")
get_uniprot_info("FKTN")
